_comment: Products are composed, not hard-coded: a product = material + range + any number of variants. Values multiply together, so 'Stainless Steel' + 'Pre-Plumbed' + 'Slimline' needs no extra data. 'available': false marks content planned for a later milestone (shown locked in game).

materials.name: Copper
materials.desc: The classic British copper cylinder. Simple, dependable, where every works begins.

materials.name: Stainless Steel
materials.desc: Unvented stainless cylinders. New materials, new machines, far better margins.

ranges.name: Thermal Store
ranges.desc: Bigger vessels with extra coils and tappings. Slower to build, worth much more.

ranges.name: Pre-Plumbed Cylinder
ranges.desc: Fitted with pumps, valves and pipework on a dedicated assembly stage.

variants.name: Slimline
variants.desc: Narrow cylinders for tight airing cupboards.

variants.name: Horizontal
variants.desc: Built to lie flat in a loft.

variants.name: Twin-Coil
variants.desc: A second coil for solar or heat pumps.
